methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Neuromeka is a public robotics and manufacturing company listed on KOSDAQ (ticker 277810.KQ) that has raised $36.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a limited peer universe of one public comparable and eight private robotics firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

The peer-median method is not applicable here. While ten same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation-tier comparables yielded fewer than three datapoints in each narrower category. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce substantial measurement error given the heterogeneity of robotics subsectors and business models. The single public comparable provides limited triangulation power, and the eight private peers lack sufficient homogeneity in stage, capital structure, or revenue scale to support a robust multiple-based valuation.

The absence of a sufficient narrow peer set constrains the precision of this analysis. Without at least three tightly comparable firms sharing stage, sector dynamics, and financial profile, traditional multiples-based approaches cannot reliably bound Neuromeka's fair value. Future valuation work should either identify additional public robotics peers trading at similar stages or establish whether private comparables warrant normalization for differences in profitability, growth rate, or capital efficiency. The company's KOSDAQ listing provides access to market pricing, which should supersede peer-based inference where current trading data is available.
